+ 6 shots at Love To Win's goal. That's an attacking mindset.
+ Match rating 8.7, up from your usual 7.3. Keep that in your back pocket.
+ On-ball actions 38, up from your usual 25. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 2. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.

- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.
- Most misplaced passes on the team: 7 (best was buddskees's 2). Mark my words: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

Couldn't have asked for more. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-2 vs Love To Win | You: 8.4 (4th best match performance)
push.body:
buddskees, an 8.4. Like a good casserole, it's not fancy, but everybody's glad it showed up.

THE GOOD
+ 91% passing on 22 attempts, up from your usual 77%. Simple, smart and successful. My three favorite S's.
+ 2 key passes. Chances like that are gifts. You were Santa out there.
+ You and PhogsToffees combined like peanut butter and banana. Underrated and delicious.
+ Won your matchup: 8.4 against their best midfielder's 7.2. Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.
+ Team-high 3 tackles attempted. You earned that one the honest way.

THE BAD
- Missed tackles 2, up from your usual 0. Lesson of the day: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike.
- Shots on target 0, down from your usual 1. Fixable, but only if we fix it.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 22 (best was PhogsToffees's 31). Best practice: Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.

Fundamentals drill: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.

Hey, buddskees. Champions are just ordinary folks who kept showing up.

Keep showing up; the results will too. - Coach Lasso

+ You and PhogsToffees linked up like peanut butter and jelly. Keep making sandwiches.
+ 0.4 above your typical game. Keep raising your own bar.
+ Shots 4, up from your usual 2. That's what showing up looks like.
+ Pass accuracy 83%, up from your usual 66%. More of that, please and thank you.

- Only 1 tackle attempted. From the clipboard: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized. Steady does it.
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Next match: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide. Biscuits if you nail it.
- Rating came in 0.5 below what your on-ball stats earned. Homework: Goal-side and central first, ball-side second. Cover the space behind the full-back when they press.
- Lowest completed passes on the team: 19 (best was PhogsToffees's 24). That's the bit that kept us from winning.

I'm in your corner, always. - Coach Lasso
